p1: In 1978, a woman picked her date on TV. She picked a serial killer.
The Dating Game. Three bachelors, hidden behind a wall.
One said he was a successful photographer. Charming. He won the date.
But backstage, Cheryl got a bad feeling. She said he was creepy.
She never went on that date. That feeling saved her life.
By then, he had already killed at least four women.
And that photographer line? That's how he got close. He'd ask to take your picture.
In 2010, police released hundreds of his photos of women. Many have never been identified.
He died in prison in 2021. Police think he may have killed up to 130 people.
If someone feels off... trust it. Follow for more true stories.
